sections.content:
Imaging workstations map S: to \\NFD-FS01\Imaging over SMB.

If S: fails, run Get-NetConnectionProfile on the PC. DomainAuthenticated cannot be set by hand: Windows sets it when the network is authenticated to a domain controller.

If the category is Public or Private, check that the PC resolves and reaches a domain controller, then check the detected category again and test S:.
